//: Type-aware linting needs EVERY lintable .ts file to belong to a TS project. The package tsconfigs deliberately exclude tests, and this layout ships no root tsconfig.json — so this file exists solely to give ESLint a project that covers them. It emits nothing and is not part of the build. Removed by the generator for stacks that drop tsconfig.base.json (python, docs, vite-flat); vite-flat repoints .eslintrc.cjs at its own root tsconfig.json instead.
